mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: conditions are clear at Badger Ridge Middle School with an elevated air quality of 63 and a New Moon overhead. Tonight will drop to a low of 54 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

In city news, the Common Council has adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to shape the future of our city, while the engineering department continues to provide regular updates on infrastructure and development projects.

There is plenty to do, with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and the Puppets in the Park festival at Century School Park tomorrow.
In our weekly police report, on October 3, officers arrested a 19-year-old Verona man who was found in possession of a stolen firearm during a traffic stop for expired registration.

Today's flavor is OREO Cookie Overload, which is a local favorite. The restaurant is currently open but will be closing its doors in 19 minutes, so there is still a small window to grab a treat tonight.
